app.title: Tabyard
app.subtitle: Automatically sort tabs into native Chrome groups · The more specific pattern wins, e.g. chrome.com/docs beats chrome.com
app.footer: After editing, click "Save & apply" to regroup all tabs with the new rules.

rules.desc: Pattern type is detected from how you write it: domain (github.com, subdomains match) · path (chrome.com/docs) · keyword (in URL or title) · regex (wrap in / /)
rules.saved: Saved and applied to all tabs
rules.savedLater: Saved (the background will apply it shortly)
